# miniz origin

- Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
- Release: 3.1.2
- Git commit: 77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d
- Retrieved: 2026-09-13
- License: MIT, see LICENSE.

All downloaded upstream source/license files are unmodified. miniz_export.h is a Mirrorfly static-library configuration header defining MINIZ_EXPORT to empty; it replaces the export header normally generated by upstream CMake. The platform library builds miniz.c, miniz_tdef.c, miniz_tinfl.c and miniz_zip.c with MINIZ_NO_STDIO, MINIZ_NO_TIME, MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_APIS and MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES. It is privately linked to mirrorfly_platform. The application reads and writes bounded ZIP data in memory and never extracts archive members to disk.

Tag verified through https://api.github.com/repos/richgel999/miniz/git/ref/tags/3.1.2. Raw files were fetched from the fixed commit; no upstream scripts were executed.
